_doc: v2 = the app ad (v1 = the battle MC). Liam advertises AFTERCODE in the first reel's voice and the dances play as examples. 'cap' = Roman Hinglish caption, 'tts' = what Liam reads; 'at' = [segment, beat] of src/config/plan.json. Pronunciation: neta = नैता, AfterCode = आफ्टरकोड (both verified with Scribe + whisper in v1). Claims: docs/factcheck.md F1-F8.
